description:
Introduce the validated issue-id type and the temporary bridge that lets each layer adopt the `IssueId` name while the workspace stays green.

## Background

Issue ids are `String` throughout: `Issue.id` and `Issue.dependencies` (`crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs:414,427`), `MinimalIssue.id` (`:670`) and `MinimalBlockedIssue.id` (`:758`). No `IssueId`, short-id or prefix type exists. Flipping `Issue.id` directly to a newtype produces 293 type errors in 32 library files before the binary, the server and the tests are reached, so adoption happens layer by layer behind an alias. About 79 `format!` sites and 136 `#[error]` attributes interpolate ids, so the newtype's `Display` must print exactly the id.

Every stored id in this repository (issue records, dependency lists, the index, events and gate runs) is a canonical lowercase hyphenated UUID produced by `IdAuthority::uuid_at` (`repository_state/mutation.rs:149-162`). `uuid` parsing also accepts simple, braced, URN and uppercase forms, so canonical decoding needs an explicit check. `InputsDigest` (`domain/repository_inputs.rs:345-403`) is the crate's newtype precedent. The short id is the first `SHORT_ID_LENGTH` (`domain/types.rs:24`) characters of the id.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A new `domain::identity` module defines the validated issue-id newtype, which accepts only the canonical lowercase hyphenated UUID form and rejects simple, braced, URN, uppercase and empty input with an error naming the input.
- [hard] REQ-02: The newtype serializes and deserializes as a plain JSON string, and its published JSON schema is `{"type":"string"}`.
- [hard] REQ-03: The newtype implements exactly `Display` (printing the same text as `as_str()`), `Debug`, `Clone`, `PartialEq`, `Eq`, `PartialOrd`, `Ord`, `Hash`, `Serialize`, `Deserialize` and `JsonSchema`, plus the methods `as_str()` and `short_id() -> &str`; `short_id()` returns the first `SHORT_ID_LENGTH` characters. It implements no `Deref`, `Borrow<str>` or comparison with strings.
- [hard] REQ-04: `crate::domain::identity::IssueId` is a temporary alias for `String`, and a temporary `IssueIdStaging` trait implemented for `String` provides `short_id()` with the same result as the newtype.
- [hard] REQ-05: Property tests show that canonical ids round-trip through parsing and serde unchanged, and that each non-canonical spelling of the same UUID is rejected.

## Notes

The alias and trait are a named temporary bridge (`@/inv/canonical-cutover`, `@/inv/convention-convergence`). A later change in this epic gives the newtype the `IssueId` name and deletes both, so until then the newtype carries a staging name. Imports use the module path `crate::domain::identity::IssueId`, which stays the same across that change.
title: Validated issue identity type with an alias staging bridge
